'''Go Kila''' was a civil servant who worked in [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]'s [[Office of Extraplanetary Relations]]. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|DO NOT delete that report, especially with the Office of Ethics involved. Those are now very official government documents. Look... UNOFFICIALLY, all I can say is your best bet is to misfile it. In the most boring place you can think of. Then feign ignorance if anyone comes looking for it.|Hu Joomi, to Go Kila|<ref name="TOR:MtN" />}}
During the [[Invasion of Manaan]] they forwarded a message to [[Hu Joomi]] of the [[Office of Ethics]] concerning reports on untapped [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] they had acquired from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and were concerned that not getting approval from the Office of Ethics would result in them "alphabetizing visitor log archives at the [[Manaan Visitor's Center]]." They sent a follow-up message complaining about bickering bureaucrats and talk of a civil war, then half-heartedly suggested they delete the report. Hu Joomi responded telling them not to delete the report, and unofficially told them to "misfile" it instead. Go Kila later received an office-wide message from the [[Director of the Office of Extraplanetary Relations]], informing everyone that they had received a communication from the [[Director of the Office of Ethics]], but considered it alarmist and welcomed the Sith Empire's co-operation.<ref name="TOR:MtN" />
